text:
ASM::conviction
Description
This iRules command will inject conviction honey traps in case of behavioral enforcement is enabled
Syntax
ASM
::
conviction
Examples
when
ASM_REQUEST_DONE
{
ASM
::
conviction
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ASM_REQUEST_DONE, ASM_REQUEST_VIOLATION
Introduced: BIGIP-15.1.0
